subject.title: feat(gateway): add context engine control API

question: Should OpenClaw expose context-engine capabilities, status, doctor, and rotate as a core Gateway/plugin control API after the session-targeting blocker is fixed?
rationale: The canonicalization bug is mechanical, but the permanent Gateway HTTP surface, optional ContextEngine hooks, and admin rotate operation define a new compatibility-sensitive API contract that needs maintainer product/API intent.

options.title: Approve after scoping fix
options.body: Keep the proposed core API direction, but require canonical session targeting, focused regression tests, and maintainer-reviewed scope/docs semantics before merge.

options.title: Narrow the control surface
options.body: Land only read-scoped capabilities/status/doctor first and defer admin rotate until maintainers are ready to own that operator action.

options.title: Defer to plugins
options.body: Pause or close the core PR and keep context-engine maintenance control on plugin/private surfaces until a broader Gateway control contract exists.

recommendation.title: Approve after scoping fix
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed core API direction, but require canonical session targeting, focused regression tests, and maintainer-reviewed scope/docs semantics before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses Gateway session ownership and method-scope boundaries where current-main history points to vincentkoc as the best available routing owner.
